sentences.en: Frogs are an indicator of the health of the forest.
sentences.zh: 1. 青蛙是森林健康状况的一个指示器。

sentences.en: Self-harm is often regarded as an indicator of insanity.
sentences.zh: 2. 自残常常被视为精神失常的一个迹象。

sentences.en: Pollen count is an indicator that allergy sufferers follow.
sentences.zh: 3. 花粉计数是过敏患者关注的指标。

senses.zh: (仪器上显示温度、压力、耗油量等的)指针，指示器，记录器 - (车辆上的)转弯指示灯 - 指示物；指示者
